heading: Patients
description: Find a patient by name, phone number or MRN.
emptyMerged: No records have been merged into another.

create.heading: Register a patient
create.description: Enter the patient details. Existing records are checked for duplicates before saving.

form.legacyIdHint: The number on the paper file or in the earlier system. Search finds the patient by it.
form.contactConsent: The patient agrees to be contacted
form.contactConsentHint: Recorded with the date and your name.

duplicate.heading: This patient may already be registered
duplicate.description: Check these records. Register a new patient only if none of them is the same person.

detail.notFoundBody: There is no such patient here, or you do not have access to the record.
detail.restricted: Your role does not include contact details

edit.heading: Edit {{name}}
edit.description: MRN {{mrn}}. The MRN cannot be changed.
edit.cancel: Cancel and go back to the record
edit.contactRestricted: Your role does not include contact details, so the phone number, email and address are not shown here and stay as they are.
edit.conflict: Someone else changed this record while you were editing it, so your changes were not saved. Their changes are shown here together with yours. Check the details, then save again.
edit.bannerNotSaved: Your changes to this record were not saved. {{reason}}
edit.bannerConflict: Someone else changed this record while you were editing it, so your changes were not saved.
edit.conflictContested: Someone else changed this record while you were editing it, so your changes were not saved. Where you both changed the same field, your version is shown and theirs is noted under it. Check those fields, then save again.

suggestions.heading_one: Someone like this is already registered
suggestions.heading_other: {{count}} people like this are already registered
suggestions.description: Check before you continue. If one of these is the same person, open their record instead of registering them again.

noResults.title: No patient matches “{{term}}”.
noResults.hint: Check the spelling, or search by a different detail: part of the name, the MRN, or the phone number.

picker.unavailable: Finding a patient needs access to patient records.

merge.heading: Merge a duplicate record
merge.note: This record stays. The duplicate you choose is marked as merged: it keeps its MRN, leaves search and can no longer be changed, and what was recorded on it moves to this record.
merge.pick: Find the duplicate to merge into this record
merge.moves: What moves to the record that stays
merge.movesNothing: Nothing recorded on the duplicate would move.
merge.permanent: A merge can be undone only for a limited time, set by the hospital.
merge.reason: Why these records are the same patient

errors.conflict: One of the records changed since you opened it. Choose the duplicate again to read the latest.
errors.merged: One of these records was already merged into another.
errors.same: Choose a different record: a record cannot be merged into itself.
errors.targetMerged: This record was merged into another and cannot take a merge.

history.heading: Records merged into this one
history.empty: No record has been merged into this one.
history.windowClosed: The window for undoing this merge has closed.
history.windowOff: Undoing merges is turned off for this hospital.

merge.mergedNotice: This record was merged into another and can no longer be changed.

undo.title: Undo this merge?
undo.body: This record becomes a separate record again: searchable and editable. What moved to the record that stayed is given back where it can be; anything recorded on that record since stays there.
undo.reason: Why the merge is being undone

errors.patient_merged: The record it was merged into has itself been merged into another, so this merge cannot be undone.
errors.unmerge_window_closed: The window for undoing this merge has closed.
errors.unmerge_unsupported: This merge cannot be undone: a part of the system that took rows from this record cannot give them back.

settings.heading: Undoing merges
settings.description: How many days after a merge it may be undone. 0 turns undoing off. Merges already made use the new value.
settings.days: Days a merge can be undone
settings.invalid: Enter a whole number of days from 0 to 365.
